gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-stack-sans-text: Stack Sans Text draws a marker-like line with big-bodied lowercase and curve endings held well apart. Stack Sans Text's partner, Snowburst One, earns its keep big and short, where its stencil bridges and tall lowercase can show off.
gen-manrope-fs-erode: Erode reads dignified and editorial, its stroke swelling and easing gently. Manrope, by contrast, draws round o shapes with a constant wall like wide portholes, while Erode keeps real weight even at its thinnest curves.
gen-manrope-fs-karma: Manrope draws every line with a constant-width pen, so nothing thins to a hairline. Karma follows with a trustworthy serif texture, its modulation gentle enough that a long passage glides along without snagging the eye.
gen-megrim-fs-bespoke-sans: Megrim finishes every stroke at one measured thickness, like a technical drafting pen gone futuristic. And Bespoke Sans, sharp and refined, leaves generous space between curve ends and stems, so a long stretch of text stays easy on the eye.
gen-megrim-gf-abeezee: Megrim's c opens as wide as a bent paperclip, angular and futuristic from the first letter. ABeeZee then keeps things approachable, its terminals finishing well clear of the stem, and that friendly gap is the pair's best trick.
gen-megrim-gf-aldrich: Megrim brings angular, futuristic lines with a skyward x-height to the heading, and Aldrich sits beneath it with a tall mean line. Aldrich's cupped round letters echo that tubular feel.
gen-megrim-gf-alexandria: Megrim's letterforms look like bent tubing. Alexandria, a clean sans with wide open terminals and short stems above and below its tall body, makes a long passage move along smoothly.
gen-megrim-gf-amiko: Amiko sets lowercase strokes as chunky as a crayon mark, with terminals pointing outward like tongs. Yet Megrim, with its thin angular drafting line, gives that plain sans a sleek, futuristic crown.
gen-megrim-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla keeps its wide s curves barely curled in. Megrim excels at angular, futuristic display lettering with horizontals as thick as verticals, while Anek Bangla is the one built for steady, approachable text.
gen-megrim-gf-anek-devanagari: Megrim's skyward x-height line gives its angular, futuristic letters an unmistakable silhouette. Anek Devanagari follows with distinctly open mouths and a tall middle zone, which lets a longer passage read modern and unhurried.
